button.label: Set selected
button.supertip: Put one value into every selected cell. Each cell's own limits still apply.

button.label: Scale %
button.supertip: Multiply the selected numbers by a percentage (110 = 10% more).

button.label: Copy from op
button.supertip: Copy one operation's values into the selected rows, for the selected columns.

button.label: Selected cells
button.supertip: Put the selected cells back to their dumped values.

button.label: Selected rows
button.supertip: Put every cell of the selected rows back to its dumped value.

button.label: Everything
button.supertip: Put the whole sheet back to the dump.

button.label: List changes
button.supertip: A Changes sheet listing every cell that differs from the dump, old and new.

button.label: SFM / RPM
button.supertip: Surface speed to RPM at a diameter, or back.

button.label: Per rev / min
button.supertip: Feed per rev to per minute at an RPM, or back.

button.label: Coolants
button.supertip: Pick several coolants for one timing - click a coolant_before / with / after cell first.
